look_here_first: Go straight to the giant velvety leaves and mature fruit. Velvetleaf has a large ~15 × 20 mm schizocarp forming a conspicuous crown of mericarps with 3–6 mm divergent spines; the style is 13–15-branched.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: many mericarps with long divergent beaks

key_traits.label: Flower
key_traits.text: Calyx ~10 mm, lobes erect in fruit; pale-yellow petals 8–13 mm; staminal column glabrous; style 13–15-branched.

key_traits.label: Fruit seed
key_traits.text: Schizocarp broadly ovoid, about 15 × 20 mm; mericarp apex spinose with divergent 3–6 mm spines; 3 seeds per mericarp, seeds 3–4 mm.

lookalikes.differences: Much larger-leaved and more strongly beaked than A. fruticosum; annual weed habit is also distinctive.
